discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 7a9bf2ae36. ShortcutRecorder now calls suspendShortcuts() for the duration of a recording, and both QuitHoldHandler and the page-level shortcut listener check areShortcutsSuspended() before acting (the quit handler also cancels any hold in progress). The recorder also uses stopImmediatePropagation() so other capture-phase listeners on window don’t see the keydown. Covered by the “suspends shortcuts until every suspension is released” test in keybindings.test.ts.

Valid, fixed in 79b8bcabc. The quit handler now calls `stopImmediatePropagation()` on a matched keydown, same as the page-level shortcuts, so the chat input never sees it. Added a test that a quit keydown on a textarea never reaches its handler.
